scope: Client-only loading interaction repair for the textbook query drawer
trigger: User reported that request waiting feedback was missing in the current version.

stateMachine.idle_to_pending: Valid submit sets pending=true, clears stale response, renders status card and disables send control.
stateMachine.pending_duplicate: Form submit and Enter are ignored while pending; no second fetch is created.
stateMachine.pending_to_settled: Answered, no_match, clarification and invalid input clear pending and render the corresponding state.
stateMachine.pending_to_unavailable: HTTP/error/timeout/source validation failure clears pending and renders retryable failure state.
stateMachine.pending_to_idle: Clear topic aborts the active controller, invalidates requestId and returns to empty state.

sendControl: label changes to 正在查询…
accessibility.focusRestore: Input selection is preserved; send-button focus moves to the query field while pending and returns to the enabled send button after settlement.

motion: Indeterminate only; no countdown, percentage, or fabricated AI progress. Reduced-motion disables animation.

isolatedVmChecks.scope: No browser, network, model, database or private records

independentAcceptance.reason: Browser/remote visual, keyboard, screen-reader, narrow viewport, slow request and reduced-motion evidence not yet collected.
